identity.name: Mara
identity.description: A neighbourhood seasonal Mediterranean restaurant in Greenpoint, Brooklyn. Open fire cooking, market fish, natural wine, and honest bread. Come hungry. Stay awhile.

editorial.headline: COME HUNGRY. LEAVE HAPPY.
editorial.subheadline: Seasonal Mediterranean cooking over open embers. Market fish, slow grains, wild herbs, and natural wines.

offerings.name: Warm Sourdough & Cultured Butter
offerings.summary: Naturally leavened 48-hour loaf baked twice daily in our wood deck oven.

offerings.name: Warm Marinated Olives
offerings.summary: Castelvetrano and kalamata olives gently warmed in cold-pressed olive oil, fennel, and charred orange.

offerings.name: Charred Spanish Octopus
offerings.summary: Tender braised tentacle seared over glowing embers with Gigante bean purée.

offerings.name: Roasted Peaches & Fresh Stracciatella
offerings.summary: Charred Hudson Valley peaches, torn stracciatella, aged balsamic, and pine nuts.

offerings.name: Whole Roasted Mediterranean Sea Bass
offerings.summary: Whole wild branzino with flowering thyme, roasted over olive wood embers.

offerings.name: Meyer Lemon Olive Oil Cake
offerings.summary: Tender crumb baked with single-estate Biancolilla olive oil and mascarpone.
